params.QUERY: SELECT table_name,column_name,unit,description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name IN ('dr4.master','dr4.photometry','dr4.images') AND column_name IN ('fwhm','mean_fwhm','flags_psf','flags','imaflags','img_qual','date','mean_epoch')

body:
table_name,column_name,unit,description
dr4.images,date,d,Modified Julian Date at the start of the exposure
dr4.images,img_qual,,Quality level of this image from 1=best to 3=worst
dr4.master,flags,,Bitwise OR of Source Extractor flags across all observations
dr4.master,flags_psf,,Bitmask indicating whether photometry is likely biased by neighbours at &gt;1%; bits 0-5 correspond to filters z-u
dr4.master,mean_epoch,d,Mean MJD epoch of the observations
dr4.master,mean_fwhm,pix,Mean FWHM of detections
dr4.photometry,flags,,Flags raised by Source Extractor
dr4.photometry,fwhm,pix,Object full width at half maximum on detector
dr4.photometry,imaflags,,"OR-combined flagged pixel types within isophotal radius from bad, saturated, and crosstalk pixel mask"
dr4.photometry,img_qual,,Quality level of this image from 1=best to 3=worst
